BiblicalUsage: Jehoshua is Joshua, the son of Nun, who led Israel into the land after Moses. In Exodus 17:9, Moses said unto Joshua. The fuller story is told on the Joshua profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Joshua belongs in the story because God put the name there, and I trust the placing.
